SELECT count(*) total, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(return_ts_utc AS DATE)<>return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_mismatch,

 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(return_ts_utc + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AS DATE)<>return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch_vs_local2
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-25' AND DATE '2026-09-05'

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, count(r.return_line_id) all_returns
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.return_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-27' AND DATE '2026-09-06'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
